artifacts.notes: 19 artifact pages = 18 offered source frames plus one modern attribution page. Source pages are photographed openings, not one-to-one printed pages. The liturgy closes at printed 19; corrections at 21–30 include a new heading at 25. Frame 13 left is an unnumbered blank, positionally [20]. Damaged page numerals 6 and 13 are mapped positionally. No exterior rear-cover frame is offered. This distinct 1677 setting does not replace the Google 20-page witness and establishes no Armenian wording or historical parentage.
